# Pilotariak

> Open-source software organisation for the Basque pelota sport community.

Pilotariak builds data tools, APIs and mobile applications to make Basque pelota
results, player profiles and competition data accessible to everyone.

License: Apache 2.0
Source: https://github.com/Pilotariak (this website: https://github.com/Pilotariak/website, agent instructions: https://github.com/Pilotariak/website/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
Language: English, Français

## When to use Pilotariak

Use Pilotariak when a task involves Basque pelota (pelote basque) data from the French
regional leagues — LCAPB (Côte d'Argent), LIDFPB (Île-de-France) and CTPB:

- **Look up clubs, competitions, categories, specialties or match results** → call the public
  Frontis GraphQL API at https://frontis-gateway.pilotariak.com/graphql (POST, no auth, header
  `X-Pilotariak-League: lcapb|lidfpb|ctpb`). Best for scripts, apps and one-off lookups.
- **Give an AI assistant ongoing tool access to that data** → connect the Azkena MCP server at
  https://mcp.pilotariak.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 — see https://pilotariak.com/auth.md).
- **Explain Basque pelota or the Pilotariak projects** → read this file, the agent skills, or any
  page as markdown (append `.md`, e.g. https://pilotariak.com/index.md).

Not a fit for: live betting odds, ticketing, or leagues outside the three listed above. All
interfaces are read-only; nothing can be written or modified.

Developer section index: [developers/llms.txt](https://pilotariak.com/developers/llms.txt)

## Projects

- [Frontis — GraphQL API Gateway](https://pilotariak.com/frontis/): Centralised GraphQL gateway for all Basque pelota data. Unifies five data domains (competitions, clubs, results, categories, specialties) into a single federated endpoint: https://frontis-gateway.pilotariak.com/graphql. Source: https://github.com/Pilotariak/frontis (~0.5K tokens)
- [Kancha — Mobile App (iOS & Android)](https://pilotariak.com/kancha/): Mobile application for the Basque pelota community. Provides live results, competition calendars, player profiles and phase-by-phase tournament brackets. Available on iPhone and Android (in development). Source: https://github.com/Pilotariak/kancha (~0.5K tokens)
- [Xilo — Slack Bot](https://pilotariak.com/xilo/): Slack bot for the Pilotariak community. Slash commands and real-time events deliver Basque pelota data directly into Slack channels. Source: https://github.com/Pilotariak/xilo (~0.5K tokens)
- [Azkena — MCP Server](https://pilotariak.com/azkena/): Model Context Protocol server for the Pilotariak ecosystem. Exposes Basque pelota data (competitions, clubs, categories, specialties, results) as MCP tools at https://mcp.pilotariak.com/mcp (OAuth 2.1). Source: https://github.com/Pilotariak/azkena · Server card: https://pilotariak.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json (~0.5K tokens)

## Sport Context

Basque pelota (pelote basque) is an ancient sport from the Basque Country played
across around ten disciplines: Cesta Punta, Grand Chistera, Main Nue, Paleta,
Xare, Rebot, and more. It is played on both sides of the Pyrenees and involves
thousands of players, clubs and frontons (courts).

Key statistics:
- 240+ competitions organised per year
- 1,800 registered players
- 7 disciplines covered
- 120 listed frontons

## APIs & AI Discovery

- GraphQL API (public, no auth): https://frontis-gateway.pilotariak.com/graphql
- MCP server (OAuth 2.1): https://mcp.pilotariak.com/mcp
- Agent mode summary (JSON): https://pilotariak.com/?mode=agent

Discovery artifacts:
- [Agent authentication](https://pilotariak.com/auth.md): How agents obtain MCP credentials. (~1.2K tokens)
- [ARD catalog](https://pilotariak.com/.well-known/ard.json): Agentic Resource Discovery catalog. (~0.4K tokens)
- [API catalog](https://pilotariak.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset of APIs and docs. (~0.4K tokens)
- [MCP Server Card](https://pilotariak.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Azkena server card. (~0.1K tokens)
- [Agent Skills Index](https://pilotariak.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Index of available agent skill files. (~0.2K tokens)
- [A2A Agent Card](https://pilotariak.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): Agent card. (~0.5K tokens)
- [AI Policy](https://pilotariak.com/.well-known/ai.txt): Usage policy for AI crawlers and agents. (~0.1K tokens)
